title: Rewrite public README and add first-run feedback intake docs
instructions: Create the next docs-only open-source readiness slice using references/operations/open-source-artifact-map.md and references/operations/open-source-public-docs-plan.md as the boundary. Rewrite README.md so the first public path starts with Samantha's trust loop and bun run samantha demo:first-run, not BK-specific dogfood history or a broad command catalog. The README must explain what Samantha is, the trust loop, quickstart first-run demo, expected success output shape, .samantha-demo cleanup behavior, non-goals for the first public path, core concepts, advanced command families, repository map, feedback path, and release maturity. Keep the README public-facing and neutral: use user/operator/local developer language, not BK as the default actor. Link accepted demo evidence at references/operations/open-source-first-run-demo-dogfood.md and record accepted demo commit 413991128f3f0718c05846d23c018a38c4c33c7f as evidence only, not as a setup requirement. Add .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/first-run-demo.yml for first-run failures and .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/workflow-feedback.yml for trust-gate/workflow feedback. The templates should ask for environment, command, runtime, stage, run log path, HARNESS_RESULT/verification evidence, cleanup status, gate friction, and expectations, while avoiding invitations to expand first-release scope into remote operation, background automation, dashboards, connector expansion, budget governance, writer parallelism, or multi-project orchestration. Add references/operations/open-source-release-note-draft.md as a short public release-note copy draft focused on first-run demo availability, public maturity, trust gates, feedback requested, and explicit not-included surfaces. Do not change package metadata, license/governance files, source, tests, examples, task templates, agent profiles, playbooks, lessons, runs, dogfood evidence, public boundary docs, or initiative docs. Do not move/delete references or generated evidence. If README rewrite honestly requires package publishing, license/governance decisions, references movement/deletion, demo command reimplementation, or a changed public/private artifact boundary, stop and report the blocker instead of editing those surfaces. End with exactly one HARNESS_RESULT line.
